# Lance — full documentation

> The local-first freelancer OS. Your business data never touches the cloud.

## Pillars

### Win work before your competition.
Proposals with scope warnings · Contract builder · Win-rate tracking.

### Track time without leaving your flow.
Project milestones · One-click timer · Unbilled-hours alerts.

### Get paid. On time, every time.
PDF + DOCX invoices · Recurring billing · Automated follow-ups · Late-fee dunning.

### Your data. Your machine.
No cloud, no accounts · Works fully offline · Nothing to breach.

### Know your numbers cold.
Finance overview · Client insights · Custom metrics per craft.

## Pricing

- Core: $0 forever — Free forever. Unlimited clients, projects, proposals.
- Pro: $99/yr ($14/mo) — $99/year ($14/mo). 30-day free trial. Launch lifetime price $149 (reg $249).
- Refunds: 30-day, no-questions-asked.

## Alternatives

- vs Bonsai (/alternatives/bonsai): Monthly fee + cloud lock-in vs your machine, your data.
- vs FreshBooks (/alternatives/freshbooks): Invoicing-first subscription vs full OS: proposals to paid.
- vs Notion + Sheets (/alternatives/notion): DIY tabs and copy-paste vs one offline loop.
- vs Excel (/alternatives/excel): Spreadsheet chaos vs milestones, timers, dunning in one place.

## Rate methodology

- Creative: $75,000 illustrative baseline. Models: day rates for shoots, per-project for deliverables, revision caps in writing. Trap: unbilled revision rounds and free 'quick changes' that eat the margin.
- Technical: $110,000 illustrative baseline. Models: hourly for maintenance, weekly rates for builds, retainers for ongoing support. Trap: scope creep disguised as 'small tweaks' and unbilled debugging time.
- Strategic: $120,000 illustrative baseline. Models: value-based project fees, monthly retainers, paid discovery phases. Trap: free strategy given away in the sales process instead of paid discovery.
- Service: $55,000 illustrative baseline. Models: session packages, hourly with minimums, monthly plans. Trap: no-shows and admin time that never makes it onto an invoice. Defaults: $6000 expenses, 25 billable hrs/wk, 4 wks off, 10% buffer. Illustrative examples, not market data.

## FAQ

- What is Lance? Local-first freelancer OS; business data never touches the cloud.
- Cost? Core free forever; Pro $99/yr; Lifetime $249.
- Privacy? No accounts, no sync, no trackers. v1 zero AI; v2 on-device optional AI.
- Refunds? 30-day no-questions-asked.
